calibration_data.archive_market: odds_series_b grid71 complete H/D/A triples; minimum 8 bookmakers
calibration_data.independent_ou: Football-Data 2015/16 BbAv>2.5 / BbAv<2.5, same four pinned blobs as R55
calibration_data.time_rule: all strict identity matches with archive match_datetime < 2016-03-01 00:00:00; no target rows
calibration_data.identity: same calendar date + normalized home + normalized away + league

baseline: exact same R55 Direct-T model specification: training only archive closing_odds 2005-2015 four English leagues, StandardScaler + L2 logistic C=1 lbfgs, target T=0..6,7+; same fixed conditional-draw models

alpha_model.objective: minimize mean binary log loss for actual T>=3 on pre-target calibration only
alpha_model.within_group: after p_new_over is fixed, preserve baseline Direct-T ratios inside T<=2 and T>=3 groups

stability_diagnostic: chronologically split pre-target calibration into 3 equal-count blocks; estimate alpha independently per block and report; block alphas do not change the full-calibration frozen alpha
stop_rule: if strict calibration n<300, STOP. Otherwise fit exactly one full-calibration alpha. If optimum alpha is effectively 0 (<=0.01) and calibration LL gain is <=0, report no usable residual and do not manufacture a nonzero weight.
target_application: after alpha is frozen and recorded, apply it exactly once to the already frozen 300; compute same Direct-T/HDA/Draw metrics and bootstrap as R55
